Stay found, folks.

I'm Cliff Hollis. Thirty-two seasons as a backcountry ranger in the mountain West, the last fifteen running search and rescue. Most of the people we went after we brought back alive. All of them came back educated. For thirty-two years I was the man they called after the mistake. This channel is me talking to you before it.

What you will find here: how people actually get lost, what actually keeps you warm, which two-dollar item does the job of the two-hundred-dollar one, where never to pitch a tent, and the habits that make a day hike come home on time. 

Every video on this channel is written from scratch and the numbers come from the Park Service and the search and rescue record, not from a catalog. Names, places and dates in the stories are changed. Footage and music are licensed. Nothing here replaces the rangers on duty where you are headed, a weather report or a first aid course; when in doubt, ask the folks at the trailhead.

New videos every day.
